subject: WillowAI throughput variance & proposed contract adjustment
messages:
From: Elena Gomez <elena@willowai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@willowai.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent: Significant throughput drop + error spike impacting production

Marissa,

We're seeing a severe throughput regression across our staging and prod tenants since ~12:30 PDT today. Error rate for batch inference requests climbed to ~18% (normally <0.5%) and average p95 latency jumped from ~180ms to ~1.4s. This is materially affecting our customer flows and several pages are timing out.

We opened a ticket with your support team (RI-9421) but haven't yet received a clear ETA for a codefix or mitigation. Our CRO is asking for a commercial remediation (credits or invoice adjustment) and a root cause timeline.

Please escalate to engineering and leadership — we need:
- Short description of scope (what parts of the platform and regions impacted)
- ETA for rollback or mitigation steps
- Proposed financial remediation for the impacted billing period

Attachment: WillowAI_incident_summary.pdf (timeline and perf charts)

Elena Gomez
Head of Platform Engineering
WillowAI
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Gomez <elena@willowai.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@willowai.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Significant throughput drop + error spike impacting production

Elena — thank you for flagging and for the summary. I'm escalating to our on-call infra + product team now and looping in Vivek and Sergio to coordinate the commercial response.

Immediate next steps we've started:
- Support has run a hot-path check and seen sustained queueing on inference workers in us-west-2; infra is collecting kv/cache metrics and request traces.
- We're enabling temporary rate-shedding and routing to warm pools to reduce 5xx and latency while we stabilize. Expect measurable relief in 30–45 minutes.
- I'll share a proposed credit framework by EOD and a candidate time for an exec sync tomorrow.

Can you share the most-critical customer segments (examples of requests you consider must-not-fail) — that'll help us scope mitigation.

Attachment: incident-timeline.csv (raw traces)

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 31 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: WillowAI commercial proposal (draft)

Team — quick internal note after reviewing the incident logs and impact window (10/30 12:28–15:10 PDT). High-level assessment: upstream network flapping triggered worker GC amplification on a subset of quantized model hosts; sustained queueing produced both elevated p95 and 5xx rates for ~2.5 hours.

Commercial proposal (draft) for review before we respond to WillowAI:
- Offer a one-time invoice credit equal to 25% of WillowAI's billed usage for October 2026 (net of discounts). This reflects the measured impact window and exec-level disruption.
- Offer a no-cost dedicated warm-pool for 30 days (priority capacity routing) while they evaluate stability with us.
- Commit to a joint post-mortem within 5 business days and a proposed SLA amendment clarifying remediation timelines and credit formula for recurrence.

Legal/finance: Rishi — please confirm whether 25% aligns with standard credit bands or if we need sign-off for a larger concession. Sergio — if you can draft a 1-page credit confirmation and a simple DocuSign addendum, I'll approve to send if legal signs off.

Attachment: proposed-credit-sheet.xlsx

Vivek
VP, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Gomez <elena@willowai.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@willowai.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 01 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Significant throughput drop + error spike impacting production

Elena / Samir — thank you again for your patience while we investigated. Below is our commercial and operational offer to make WillowAI whole for the disruption.

What we're proposing:
1) One-time invoice credit equal to 25% of WillowAI's October 2026 usage (this credit will be applied to your next invoice).
2) Immediate provisioning of a dedicated warm pool for 30 days (priority routing + brief configuration support from our infra team) at no extra charge.
3) Joint post-mortem meeting with our infra and product leadership on Nov 5 to walk the root cause, mitigations, and a durable SLA amendment.
4) Draft SLA amendment (attached) that clarifies incident triggers, credit calculation methodology, and an optional penalty escalation ladder for repeat breaches. If you accept the credit terms we can route the amendment via DocuSign for signature: https://docusign.net/recent/abc123

Attachment: sla-amendment-draft.docx
Ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/ticket/RI-9421
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/record/67890

If this package looks reasonable I'll send a short confirmation email and a one-page credit letter for your finance team. Would 4pm PT tomorrow work for an exec-level call?
